text: Convinced the Antichrist will be born in Madrid at midnight on Christmas Eve, the Basque priest Ángel commits every sin he can so that he can [sell his soul to Satan|rules|everything has a price] and stop the birth. With José María, a heavy metal fan from Carabanchel, he kidnaps the television occultist Professor Cavan and [completes a ritual with a virgin's blood and LSD|trigger|calling on unseen powers]. A he-goat appears, and the trail leads to the Gate of Europe, where [the devil leads a gang of killers|threat|the devil and dark gods].
